user_query: My family and I are planning a vacation in Thailand and we want to visit some popular tourist attractions. Can you recommend some must-visit attractions in the provinces of Phuket and Chiang Mai? Additionally, I would like to know the trending search results in Thailand to gather more information about popular destinations.

TaskList.description: Fetch recommended tourist attractions in Phuket.
Fetch recommended tourist attractions in Chiang Mai.
Fetch trending search results for popular destinations in Thailand.
Compile and summarize the findings from tasks 1, 2, and 3.
